title: Eggplant Pasta Bake
description: A delicious and easy eggplant pasta bake with a smoky flavor, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is a great way to get your daily dose of veggies in a tasty and satisfying way.

ingredients.name: Pasta
ingredients.notes: short, sturdy shape like penne or rigatoni

instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add sliced eggplant to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until tender and lightly browned.
Transfer eggplant to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the pasta to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Stir in the zesty Italian seasoning and salt to taste.
Add the cooked pasta to the baking dish with the eggplant.
Toss the pasta and eggplant together until well combined.
Top the pasta and eggplant with grated Parmesan cheese, if using.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
